findings.highlight: running at great speed, striking at her enemy from all possible directions
findings.evidenceJa: 地面を駆け、地表上空、前後左右から目まぐるしく標的へ襲いかかる
findings.governingReading: Rider races along the ground and attacks dizzyingly through the air above it from front, rear, left, and right.
findings.explanation: “All possible directions” preserves multiplicity but removes the ground-to-air alternation and exact four-way geometry.

findings.highlight: Her long hair blown behind her
findings.evidenceJa: 長い髪を引いて走り抜ける姿
findings.governingReading: Rider runs past drawing her long hair in a streaming trail.
findings.explanation: The English attributes the hair’s position to wind rather than her extraordinary forward motion.

findings.highlight: The swordsman who Rider faces.
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーが標的とする剣士
findings.governingReading: The swordswoman targeted by Rider is Saber.
findings.explanation: The English uses the male-specific “swordsman” for Saber.

findings.highlight: break through Saber’s guard, as she firmly fixes herself on the ground and overwhelms Rider
findings.evidenceJa: 泰然と地上に構え、ライダーの猛攻を迎撃し圧倒する
findings.governingReading: Saber stands composed on the ground, intercepts Rider’s fierce assault, and overwhelms her.
findings.explanation: The English invents a discrete “guard” as Rider’s objective and weakens calm composure into physical fixation.

findings.highlight: deflects the daggers
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーの短剣を全て弾き返し
findings.governingReading: Saber turns aside every one of Rider’s daggers with a single swing.
findings.explanation: The English removes both Rider’s ownership and the exhaustive scope of every dagger.

findings.highlight: striking Rider in the same motion
findings.evidenceJa: 返す刃で確実にライダーを“壊して”いく
findings.governingReading: With the returning blade, Saber certainly continues breaking Rider down.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the counterstrike but removes certainty, progressive destruction, and the marked language of “breaking” Rider.

findings.highlight: A large star that will consume you once you draw near.
findings.evidenceJa: 近づけば燃え尽きる巨大な恒星
findings.governingReading: Saber is a massive star against which an approaching body burns itself out.
findings.explanation: “Consume you” shifts the image from self-burning proximity to the star actively devouring a generic reader.

findings.highlight: No matter how fast Rider may move, an ephemeral shooting star can never match the light of one that burns in place.
findings.evidenceJa: いかに宙を駆けようと、刹那に消え行く流星に太刀打ちできる道理はない
findings.governingReading: However it races through the sky, a meteor that vanishes in an instant has no reason to match a massive fixed star.
findings.explanation: The English adds speed and comparative light as the grounds of defeat, weakening the source contrast in scale, duration, and existence.

findings.highlight: she’s wounded
findings.evidenceJa: 体を削られるライダー
findings.governingReading: Each repelled surprise attack has Rider’s body physically pared away.
findings.explanation: “Wounded” removes the attritional image of her body being shaved down piece by piece.

findings.highlight: Natural healing that regenerates the wounds Saber sustains.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーによって傷つけられた体を癒す自然治癒
findings.governingReading: Rider spends resources on natural healing of the body Saber has wounded.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the wounds and their regeneration to Saber, reversing who is being injured and healed.

findings.highlight: She can’t match Saber
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを抑えきれない
findings.governingReading: Rider must burn all fuel merely to keep Saber fully suppressed.
findings.explanation: The English changes a defensive containment requirement into general competitive equality.

findings.highlight: Her energy’s lost with every passing second.
findings.evidenceJa: 刻一刻と失われていく体力
findings.governingReading: Rider’s physical stamina is being lost with every moment.
findings.explanation: “Energy” blurs stamina with the separate magical-energy reserve named later.

findings.highlight: legs are starting to give in to the strain
findings.evidenceJa: 両脚は過度の酷使で、内部から崩壊しだしている
findings.governingReading: Both legs are beginning to collapse internally from extreme overuse.
findings.explanation: The English weakens internal structural collapse and excessive abuse into ordinary fatigue.

findings.highlight: It’s only a matter of time before Saber catches up to Rider’s speed.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーがライダーを捉えるのは時間の問題
findings.governingReading: It is only a matter of time before Saber catches Rider.
findings.explanation: The English invents Saber matching Rider’s speed, changing the predicted decisive capture into a speed comparison.

findings.highlight: The instant Rider loses her strength and magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 体力と魔力を失い、全力を出せなくなった瞬間
findings.governingReading: The instant lost stamina and mana prevent Rider from exerting full power, Saber will bisect her.
findings.explanation: The English omits inability to exert full power as the condition that opens the fatal attack.

findings.highlight: The boy told Rider of his prediction
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーが少年に告げた戦いの結末
findings.governingReading: Before entering the cavern, Rider told the boy this exact outcome of the battle.
findings.explanation: The English directly reverses speaker and recipient, making Shirou the forecaster instead of Rider.

findings.highlight: I’m losing my comprehension
findings.evidenceJa: 泣きたくなるぐらい、理解できなくなっていく
findings.governingReading: Shirou is losing comprehension of visible things to a degree that makes him want to cry.
findings.explanation: The English preserves cognitive loss but removes its acute emotional degree.

findings.highlight: I’ll lose everything.
findings.evidenceJa: 失う。
findings.governingReading: The fragmented thought says only “I will lose,” before narrowing to something precious.
findings.explanation: The English supplies “everything,” expanding an intentionally objectless fear into total loss.

findings.highlight: I… have to do… what I can… and fight.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は　　俺も　　自分にできる事で、たたか、
findings.governingReading: The broken thought catches between “I” and “I too” before failing during the word “fight.”
findings.explanation: The English smooths away the self-correction that aligns Shirou’s effort with Rider’s and completes more of the damaged syntax.

findings.highlight: [blank page]
findings.evidenceJa: 選出→解析。
findings.governingReading: The Projection process advances from selection to analysis.
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the entire active system-state page blank, removing a distinct technical transition.

findings.highlight: [blank page]
findings.evidenceJa: 保留。保留。保留。保留。
findings.governingReading: The Projection process repeats “hold” four times while Shirou waits for Rider’s cue.
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the active page blank, removing both the technical state and its four-beat suspended timing.

findings.highlight: Rider’s fighting her fight.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は命を預けると言った。
findings.governingReading: Shirou remembers that Rider said she would entrust her life to him.
findings.explanation: The English removes the explicit life-trust that makes his refusal to fail reciprocal rather than merely tactical.

findings.highlight: I give all I have to keep watching Rider.
findings.evidenceJa: 全霊を以ってライダーを直視しろ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou commands himself to look directly at Rider with the whole of his spirit.
findings.explanation: “All I have” generalizes the specifically spiritual and attentional force of the command.

findings.highlight: Saber’s sword moves.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの剣が翻る。
findings.governingReading: Saber’s sword turns or flashes into the attacking motion.
findings.explanation: “Moves” removes the blade’s sudden turning action at the scene cutoff.
